findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "remove_member" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: DESTRUCTIVE and cannot be undone: removes a person from the company. A joined member loses access to the company and its signature; a pending invitation is with…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_install_steps, get_signature, add_member · Public sink: create_signature, get_install_steps, get_signature, update_my_signature, add_member, update_member_field, resend_invite · Destructive: remove_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_install_steps, get_signature, add_member · Public sink: create_signature, get_install_steps, get_signature, update_my_signature, add_member, update_member_field, resend_invite · Destructive: remove_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
